rule_gaps: Kicks rows arrive with the variant label appended to a name that already ends in it ('… 100 ml 100 ml', '… Golden Tan Golden Tan') — 33 of the shard's 300 rows; strip a trailing duplicate of the last token run in scrapeRow rather than patching each product

'mousse' derives facets.type=Hair care with no hair evidence, so every self-tan mousse is typed Hair care; likewise 'cream'/'balm' beat eye/lip/cleansing evidence (Bobbi Brown Cream Shadow Stick → Moisturisers, Biovène Cleansing Balm → Moisturisers)
the Beauty type rules only read English/Norwegian: French 'Crème'/'Masque' (Biologique Recherche) and 'Eau de Cologne' derive nothing
false-lash rows (Ardell, blik — 7 rows under 'Sminke > Øyne > Løsvipper') derive no type at all; 'løsvipper'/'lash' should map to Eyes
a department crumb outranks the leaf for type: 'Hjem > Parfyme > … > Bad & dusj' body washes and 'Merker > Parfyme > … > BARBERING' shaving cream all come out Fragrance
'ansiktsmaske(r)' pulls outdoor headwear (Brynje balaclava) into Beauty, and 'solkrem' inside a mixed crumb ('Hudpleieprodukter og solkremer') types anti-chafe balm as Sun care
notes: Category accuracy is high (6 real mismatches in 300, all from a single ambiguous crumb — pet-shop rows, a candle, a bathroom scale, a jewellery box, a balaclava); the real damage is systematic and mechanical — a Kicks name-duplication bug on 33 rows, ~50 rows of unwired makeup shade families, and a facet vocabulary that lets generic words ('cream', 'mousse', 'parfyme') beat the specific leaf crumb.
